meta.prompt: Run a quick team poll in a card: "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?" with four options and their votes so far: Pho Saigon 5, Taqueria Luz 8, Green Bowl 3, Napoli Pizza 6. Before I vote I only see the options. When I vote, my vote is counted and I see each option's share as a bar with the percentage (rounded to a whole number), my choice marked as mine, and the total number of votes.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Team lunch poll" "Friday" icon:"how_to_vote" status:"Open"
  Paragraph "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?"
  state pick=""
  state votes={"Pho Saigon":5,"Taqueria Luz":8,"Green Bowl":3,"Napoli Pizza":6}
  let total = sum(map(["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"], n => votes[n]))
  if pick==""
    OptionList "Choose one" =pick options:["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"] -> votes=with(votes,pick,votes[pick]+1)
  if pick!=""
    Column gap:10
      Text.strong "Results"
      Column gap:8
        Row gap:8
          Text.body "Pho Saigon"
          Spacer grow
          Text.muted "{round(votes[\"Pho Saigon\"]*100/total,0)}%"
          if pick=="Pho Saigon"
            Text.success "Your vote"
        Progress =share1
        Row gap:8
          Text.body "Taqueria Luz"
          Spacer grow
          Text.muted "{round(votes[\"Taqueria Luz\"]*100/total,0)}%"
          if pick=="Taqueria Luz"
            Text.success "Your vote"
        Progress =share2
        Row gap:8
          Text.body "Green Bowl"
          Spacer grow
          Text.muted "{round(votes[\"Green Bowl\"]*100/total,0)}%"
          if pick=="Green Bowl"
            Text.success "Your vote"
        Progress =share3
        Row gap:8
          Text.body "Napoli Pizza"
          Spacer grow
          Text.muted "{round(votes[\"Napoli Pizza\"]*100/total,0)}%"
          if pick=="Napoli Pizza"
            Text.success "Your vote"
        Progress =share4
      Text.caption "{total} votes in total"

let share1 = votes["Pho Saigon"]/total
let share2 = votes["Taqueria Luz"]/total
let share3 = votes["Green Bowl"]/total
let share4 = votes["Napoli Pizza"]/total
